description: Maison Skye & Rose — Normalized supplier catalogue intake. Machine-readable enrichment layer over raw supplier data. Raw provenance preserved via sourceKey. Raw supplier text is never overwritten in this file.

reconciliationPrinciples: RELEVANCE IS NOT IDENTITY. SIMILARITY IS NOT IDENTITY.
A supplier entry is only matched to a Maison product when the normalized names are the same fragrance identity — not merely similar or adjacent.
Flanker pairs, concentration variants, and flanker-adjacent names are NOT automatically collapsed into the base product.
Full-string normalized matching is used — not substring or fuzzy matching.
When uncertain: AMBIGUOUS or UNRESOLVED. Never guess.
SUPPLIER_LISTED availabilityStatus means the fragrance appears in the supplier's catalogue. It does NOT confirm current stock or guaranteed availability.

statusDefinitions.EXACT_SUPPLIER_MATCH: Supplier entry is confirmed as the same fragrance identity as an existing Maison product. Names match exactly (or trivially — case/punctuation only).
statusDefinitions.NORMALIZED_CONFIRMED: Supplier entry confirmed as the same fragrance after brand-prefix/suffix normalization. Same fragrance identity, different naming format.
statusDefinitions.AMBIGUOUS: Supplier entry is similar to or adjacent to a Maison product but may be a different variant, flanker, or concentration. Identity NOT confirmed. Review required before processing.
statusDefinitions.UNRESOLVED: Supplier entry requires external research to establish canonical identity. Do not process until resolved.
statusDefinitions.NEW_SUPPLIER_CANDIDATE: Supplier entry does not match any existing Maison product. Eligible for Wave planning after identity verification and Founder approval.
